english.title: Unregistered person describe self as registered trade mark agent or attorney
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) carried on a business (otherwise than in partnership) under a name or other description which contained the words

(A)_['registered trade mark agent']_
(B)_[registered trade mark attorney]_

when not a registered trade mark attorney
english.legislation: Contrary to section 84(1)(a) and (4) of the Trade Marks Act 1994.

english.notes:
(i) For offences committed by partnerships or bodies corporate see section 101.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see section 84(4)

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
